class.name: IfcAnnotation
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI : An annotation is a graphical representation within the geometric (and spatial) context of a project, that adds a note or meaning to the objects which constitutes the project model. Annotations include additional line drawings, text, dimensioning, hatching and other forms of graphical notes. NOTE Additional presentation information (often 2D) such as tag number, hatching, etc.

members.member: Relationship to a spatial structure element, to which the associate is primarily associated.
